optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id, s.s_state, grouping(s.s_state) AS g_state, avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1, avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2, avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'M'
AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
AND d.d_year = 1999
AND s.s_state in ('TN','TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((i.i_item_id, s.s_state), (i.i_item_id), ())
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, s.s_state
LIMIT 100
